weakness: No MFA on the patrol app admin account; email on text-message codes
remediation_plan: App-based MFA on the patrol app admin account and email; recovery codes in the sealed copy in the safe
milestones: 2026-08-12 password changed; 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested on both

weakness: Client codes in a spreadsheet, a note, and texts; keys labeled with site names in an unlocked vehicle; no key count; no code-change practice
source: P07 assessment (PE-03 objectives); P03 G-009 and G-019
remediation_plan: Codes into the password manager vault plus one sealed paper copy; delete the spreadsheet, note, and texts; coded key tags; bolted vehicle lockbox; monthly key count; ask clients to change codes after any exposure and to stop texting codes
milestones: 2026-09-15 codes moved and copies deleted; former client's codes deleted; 2026-10-31 lockbox installed and tags replaced; first monthly count 2026-11-02
resources_required: Password manager (about $40 a year); lockbox about $150; owner time

weakness: Code spreadsheet unprotected; body-camera card not encrypted and holding clips back to 2024
remediation_plan: Delete the spreadsheet once codes are in the vault (POAM-002); copy clips off after each shift and clear the card weekly; delete clips past 90 days not tied to an incident
milestones: 2026-09-15 spreadsheet deleted; 2026-09-30 card cleared and 90-day purge done

weakness: Reused password; default router password; passwords saved in a shared browser; no lost-authenticator procedure
remediation_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases; separate laptop accounts; written steps for a lost phone or flagged password (POL-01 7.3 and P08)
milestones: 2026-08-12 router and patrol app passwords changed; 2026-09-15 password manager and separate accounts in use

weakness: No backup of files, codes, or video outside the sync service
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. and CP-09c.); P03 G-012
remediation_plan: Versioned backup service the laptop cannot overwrite; business file area replaces the consumer drive; quarterly restore test of one folder
milestones: 2026-10-31 backup running and first restore test passed
resources_required: Backup service about $100 a year; business email and file plan about $110 a year

weakness: Client portal accounts created without written requests; 3 stale accounts; no review
remediation_plan: Confirm and remove the 3 stale accounts; written request for new accounts; ask clients to report departures; quarterly review; MFA for client users
milestones: 2026-09-15 stale accounts removed after client confirmation; 2026-10-31 first quarterly review and client MFA on

weakness: Patrol app and email sign-in logs never reviewed
source: P07 assessment (AU-06 objectives); P03 G-036 and G-037
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first Monday with a one-page checklist; weekly for 3 months after any incident; sign-in alerts on
